business_meaning: Surrogate key for a savings-account version
documented_rules: Surrogate key / primary key for a savings-account version; One row per version of a savings account (SCD Type‑2).
inferred_rules: Unique surrogate per row; not null; used as FK in fact tables; one-to-one with a single dimension row.

documented_rules: Unique savings account number; Unique per account version; AccountNumber is mandatory.
inferred_rules: Natural key for account; must be unique per active business account across SCD2 versions; non-empty; conforms to varchar length (implementation uses varchar(20)).

documented_rules: Source-system customer identifier; One customer can hold several accounts.
inferred_rules: Must reference an existing customer in DimParty (referential integrity); non-empty.

documented_rules: ProductCode is mandatory; Allowed values include EASY_ACCESS, FIXED_1Y, NOTICE_90, ISA.
inferred_rules: Must be one of allowed product codes; when FIXED_1Y, AccountMaturityDate must be populated; non-empty.

documented_rules: AccountStatus is mandatory; Allowed values: OPEN, CLOSED, DORMANT, FROZEN.
inferred_rules: When AccountStatus = CLOSED then AccountCloseDate must be populated; status must be one of allowed values; status may affect Balance business rules (e.g., zero balance on CLOSED).

documented_rules: AccountOpenDate must be populated; Date ordering: AccountOpenDate must be earlier than AccountMaturityDate where populated.
inferred_rules: Must be <= today; must be <= AccountCloseDate if AccountCloseDate populated; must be earlier than AccountMaturityDate when that exists; non-null.

documented_rules: AccountMaturityDate is nullable; Mandatory when ProductCode = FIXED_1Y.
inferred_rules: If populated must be > AccountOpenDate; when ProductCode = FIXED_1Y it must be populated; otherwise should be NULL for non-term products.

documented_rules: AccountCloseDate is nullable; Mandatory when AccountStatus = CLOSED.
inferred_rules: If populated must be >= AccountOpenDate and <= today; must be populated when AccountStatus = CLOSED; otherwise NULL for active accounts.

business_meaning: SCD2 start timestamp for this version
documented_rules: SCD2 start timestamp for this version; Curate ValidFrom is used to set load dates; Dim uses ValidFrom and ValidTo with 9999-12-31 for current.
inferred_rules: Must be non-null; ValidFrom < ValidTo; ValidFrom used as row effective start; no overlapping [ValidFrom,ValidTo] ranges per natural key; Load process sets this daily.

business_meaning: SCD2 end timestamp for this version
documented_rules: SCD2 end timestamp for this version; current-version convention uses 9999-12-31.
inferred_rules: Must be non-null; current row uses 9999-12-31; ValidTo > ValidFrom; SCD2 ranges must not overlap for same natural key; historical rows have ValidTo set to previous row's end.

business_meaning: Current-version flag added at the Presentation layer
documented_rules: IsCurrent indicates current version (1 = current version) added at Presentation layer.
inferred_rules: Exactly one row per natural key must have IsCurrent = 1; IsCurrent = 1 should correspond to ValidTo = 9999-12-31; IsCurrent not null.
